doe_encode — MULTIVAR coding op

• Data kinds: matrix → design

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.doe_encode(natural=None, factors=None) -> 'dict' (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import doe; doe.doe_encode(natural=None, factors=None) -> 'dict', registry से लेना हो तो opsmultivar.get("doe_encode"))

उपयोग

प्राकृतिक इकाइयों की settings (n, k) -> coded मानों (−1..+1 = lo..hi) वाला design।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

Use it to bring runs that were *not* planned here (a historical log, a hand-made plan) into the same coded frame the analysis ops read. factors gives the ranges (and per-factor "log" scale: coded = position of log10(x) between log10(lo) and log10(hi)). Values outside lo..hi are kept (coded beyond ±1) and named in meta['outside_range'].
